verdict.rationale: Close's developer docs say they provide full endpoint docs with schemas, examples, and an interactive API explorer, and they publish an OpenAPI spec that a probe confirmed is reachable. That covers the core of an interactive, example-rich API reference. However, the evidence is a single first-party line, with no detail on whether examples execute live against your account. Missing for 10: confirmation that examples actually run with your own credentials, any description of how the explorer works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer.
